text:
incident-bot: ALERT: autoscaler fallback engaged in eu-west-3. Affected pool: gpu-standard-rt. Reason: regional GPU quota shortage / high preemptions. Pager: @jordan.oncall

jordan.oncall: I'm on pager. Seeing surge of preemptions and scale failures, starting mitigation. Will open cross-region routing to us-east-1 and enable cpu-safe fallback for non-latency-critical routes.

maya.sre: On it — confirmed repeated preempts from AZ B. Autoscaler logs show repeated OOM-style evictions + insufficient quota. Pulling `autoscaler-controller` logs now.

raj.infra: I'll prepare the routing change. Command I'll run: 
```
rctl route set --from eu-west-3 --to us-east-1 --pool-mapping gpu-standard-rt:gpu-standard-rt-fallback --drain-seconds 60
```
I'll also bump the cluster retry window to reduce flapping.

jordan.oncall: Paste of recent errors from autoscaler: 
```
E0321 22:12:01 autoscaler.go:412] scale loop: failed to provision: quotaExceeded: requested 8 GPUs, available 2
E0321 22:12:07 preempt-monitor.go:87] instance preempted: instance-id i-0a3f... zone eu-west-3b
```

emily.prod: Any customer-facing impact yet? CS flagged anything?

luis.cs: CS got 2 Priority-2 reports about timeouts from EU customers; embedding batch jobs timing out and retrying. Customers: CUST-421 (analytics) and CUST-887 (search). They're seeing 500s and increased retries. I told them we're investigating.

maya.sre: Metrics: p95 token latency for embeddings in eu-west-3 jumped from ~210ms -> ~1.2s after 22:08 UTC, error rate spike +3.4%. Failover started at ~22:14 UTC. Monitoring: https://prom.redwood/internal/graphs/embedding-eu-west-3

ops-bot: ACTION: route change applied. 78% of traffic for pool gpu-standard-rt now routed to us-east-1 pool gpu-standard-rt-fallback. Note: fallback uses quantized-small model variant (expected quality delta).

raj.infra: Quick action items (summary):
1) revert autoscaler min replicas bump to baseline (owner: raj.infra)
2) request regional GPU quota increase with cloud provider (owner: emily.prod)
3) customer comms draft and postmortem sync (owner: luis.cs)
4) add stronger preemption detection to autoscaler (owner: maya.sre)
5) add cross-region failover test to CI (owner: raj.infra)
Please ack owners.

jordan.oncall: I will own incident for the next 2 hours and coordinate mitigation. Handoff plan: I'll hand to @maya.sre at 01:00 UTC if still open.

emily.prod: Proposing a postmortem meeting: 2026-03-16 16:00 UTC (30m) — to include infra, SRE, product, CS. Tentative link: https://calendar.redwood/meet/pm-1804506789. Please confirm availability.

maya.sre: Runbook notes appended here for follow-ups: 
```
# Runbook excerpt - detect and mitigate regional GPU shortage
1. Check `kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu-standard-rt` and `gcloud compute reservations describe` for quota.
2. If preemption rate >10/min, enable cross-region routing: `rctl route set ...` (see above).
3. If fallback in effect, monitor p95 and SLO error impact and notify CS.
```

raj.infra: Completed: reverted min replicas to baseline and tuned scheduler backoff. Also kicked an emergency quota request (ticket #Q-1293).

luis.cs: I'll send initial customer note: short summary + ETA for follow-up. Will include list of affected customers and invite to a follow-up call if they want.

emily.prod: Confirmed postmortem scheduled and owner for write-up: @raj.infra + @maya.sre to draft technical section, @emily.prod to lead impact/mitigation timeline, @luis.cs to add customer impact notes. Draft due by 2026-03-15 23:59 UTC.

jordan.oncall: Leaving detailed logs and timeline below for the handoff. If anything new pops, ping me. Otherwise handing to @maya.sre at 01:00 UTC. :handshake:

ops-bot: NOTE: Creating follow-up issue in Jira: INF-4532 "Regional GPU quota shortage - remediation & tests". Link: https://jira.redwood/browse/INF-4532

maya.sre: Acknowledged handoff. Next steps: 1) validate us-east-1 capacity overnight, 2) run synthetic failover test tomorrow 09:00 UTC, 3) prepare autoscaler improvements PR. I'll update this thread with progress.

jordan.oncall: Closing active pager for now — mitigation in place and CS notified. Moving this thread into remediation tracking mode. :white_check_mark:

emily.prod: Thanks team. We'll use INF-4532 for tracking and the postmortem doc for long-term actions. Please add evidence links to the postmortem (logs, graphs, customer comms).

luis.cs: Added initial customer draft to the shared drive and pinged the two customers. I'll post updates here if they escalate.

raj.infra: Left TODO in INF-4532: include runbook improvements + add quota request template. ETA for infra fixes: 7 days.

maya.sre: Leaving a final status update before sleeping: failover stable, error rate returned to baseline ~22:45 UTC, ongoing follow-ups in INF-4532.

jordan.oncall: last note: thanks all, great ops.
